_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Canara Visa Gold Secured Credit Card

eligibility_engine.notes: FD-backed; the page states the eligible limit as up to 100% of the FD and, in a repeated block, as up to 75%; minimum card limit ₹25,000; maximum credit limit ₹25,00,000 (Features).

action.reason: 2 points per ₹100 on every POS and e-commerce spend (Features table on the card page). No category exclusions, accelerators or caps are stated on the page.

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: Railway tickets on www.irctc.co.in: 1% of the transaction amount; at railway counters ₹30 + 2.5% of the transaction amount (Fee and Charges tab)

components: all applicable charges, fees and taxes

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Enrolment, joining and annual fees are nil (Fee and Charges tab).

insurance_and_protection.claim_condition: Death due to air accident: ₹4,00,000 for the cardholder, ₹2,00,000 for the spouse (Features table).
Death due to accident other than air: ₹2,00,000 for the cardholder, ₹1,00,000 for the spouse (Features table).

direct_options.channel: Canara Rewardz: cashback or goods purchase (canararewardz.com)

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: Canara Bank Canara Visa Gold Secured Credit Card page (Benefits, Features, Eligibility, Fee and Charges tabs, plain fetch 2026-11-15)
Canara Rewardz home page (redemption site named by the card pages): states no point value

open_questions: Network (visa): stated by the card name and the Features table heading "VISA Gold Secured Credit Card" on the Canara page; no tier is stated.

Point value: the page says points redeem for "Cashback or Goods Purchase through canararewardz.com" but states no rupee value for a point, and the Canara Rewardz home page states none. point_value_inr_baseline is null. A person should confirm from the Canara Rewardz catalogue or the Canara reward-points circular.

Finance charge: the Visa Gold Features table says 2% a month (24% a year) "for Secured Credit Cards"; the Fee and Charges tab still says 2.50% a month for "all other credit cards". The secured-card figure of 2% is used.

Fee text on the page is shared across the Canara credit-card tabs: the Features table, eligibility block (credit limit as a share of the FD) and the Fee and Charges block are repeated for the secured and unsecured variants, and the eligible limit is stated as both 75% and 100% of the FD on the same page. Joining, enrolment and annual fees are "Nil" in the secured Features table itself, which is what is used; the limit rule is left as an open question.

Fuel surcharge: the page says 1% (minimum ₹10) is charged and "maximum of ₹100 for the billing month would be reimbursed" if the card is used for at least ₹2,500 of purchases that month and each fuel purchase is at least ₹400; modelled as a 1% waiver with a ₹100 monthly cap and ₹400 minimum.
Forex: the page says "Upto 3% of transaction amount" and 3% is used. Cash withdrawal at Canara ATMs 3% with a ₹150 minimum (Fee and Charges tab); Features tab says ₹30 per ₹1,000.
The Canara MITC PDF linked from the page (file dated 18 Dec 2023 in its name) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-15, so no MITC was read.
Inactivity fee when the annual turnover is below the stated threshold: ₹100 a year in the Features table versus ₹150 in the Fee and Charges tab (threshold ₹25,000); not modelled.

Lounge access: not available (Features table). The page lists a current GoIbibo offer (12% on domestic flights, 15% on hotels, 9% on buses, 10% on outstation cabs); an expired-by-default seasonal offer, not modelled.
notes: FD-backed secured card issued against deposits in the applicant's name (joint deposits with "Either or Survivor" accepted; add-on cards to other joint depositors).
Late payment fee ₹250 + GST, in addition to finance charges on the carried-over balance (Fee and Charges tab).
Insurance: personal accident cover for self and spouse; baggage cover and purchase protection up to ₹25,000 (Features table).
